headline: How to turn off AI in your Google Docs
summary: Annoying Gemini pop-ups and "help me write" features are disrupting workflows in Google Docs. Learn how to disable these smart features across your Google Workspace to regain control of your writing.
details: Google Docs users are encountering intrusive AI features like "write with Gemini" pop-ups, disrupting their workflow. These prompts appear immediately upon opening a document, making it difficult to focus on writing.
Attempts to dismiss these features, even by asking Gemini itself, often prove unhelpful or misleading. The AI might suggest closing a conversation rather than disabling its presence entirely.

Other users report a persistent "help me write" feature that hovers over the cursor, adding to the distraction. This widespread integration has led to frustration among those who prefer an uninterrupted writing environment.

Instead of tackling each AI feature individually, the solution lies in disabling "smart features" across your entire Google Workspace. This can be done through Gmail settings, providing a comprehensive fix.
caption:
Tired of Gemini AI pop-ups disrupting your Google Docs? Learn the simple, comprehensive way to disable "smart features" across your entire Google Workspace.

Google Docs users are encountering intrusive AI features like "write with Gemini" pop-ups, disrupting their workflow. These prompts appear immediately upon opening a document, making it difficult to focus on writing.

Attempts to dismiss these features, even by asking Gemini itself, often prove unhelpful or misleading. The AI might suggest closing a conversation rather than disabling its presence entirely.

Other users report a persistent "help me write" feature that hovers over the cursor, adding to the distraction. This widespread integration has led to frustration among those who prefer an uninterrupted writing environment.

Instead of tackling each AI feature individually, the solution lies in disabling "smart features" across your entire Google Workspace. This can be done through Gmail settings, providing a comprehensive fix.
